steps: 1. In **Equipment > Weapons > Weapon Availability > Melee: Handmaiden**, enable **Kruber: Tuskgor Spear** and leave it enabled throughout.
2. Equip the Tuskgor Spear on Handmaiden in one saved Equipment row; record its Roman numeral. Give a second row a different weapon.
3. Switch between both rows, recreate inventory, then return normally to the title screen and exit without re-equipping the spear.
4. Relaunch into the Modded Keep and inspect both rows. Repeat the normal exit/relaunch cycle twice more and retain the logs.
assertions: The chosen Handmaiden row retains the enabled Tuskgor Spear through every switch, screen reconstruction and restart. The control row and official loadouts remain unchanged.
Three exit/relaunch cycles: assert stored Handmaiden melee row id resolves to the spear each launch, official rows unchanged, exit-snapshot receipts present.
